name: Rare Combo Catalog
tagline: Organizes scattered rare-condition findings into a gap table and doctor questions
description: A research organizer for families living with a rare condition combination. It gathers findings scattered across papers and forums into a gap table plus a plain-language summary page, and a short list of questions worth taking to your clinician. Questions, never verdicts: the diagnosis stays with the professionals.
author: BiancaBellChamb
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
